specificFindings: That is the reality refers to acknowledged adult responsibilities, not absence of duties. Once in a while qualifies playful freedom as occasional; vacation is not a literal compulsory trip or permanent abandonment of obligations.
Sing along is joining a performance, without needing an actual private lesson, physical meeting or professional status. These are illustrative playful activities, not completed real user actions.
A lot at stake refers to important consequences, not only financial gambling. For instance the Olympics is an example, not the only place where playfulness can matter.
Phelps training at eight and age-group records are distinct from Bowman guidance from eleven. Continued does not mean first ever training. Sister Hilary is a separate person from coach Bowman.

Olympic-level swimmer describes the sister without inventing her medal tally or specific Olympic participation. Soaked in is immersion in competitive-swimming environment, not literal wetness throughout childhood.
Also adds weightlifting and stretching, not a replacement for swimming. Another introduces Biles as an additional example rather than an identical biography or rank comparison between the two.

Biles overall medal statement is restricted to American gymnasts, Olympic medals and the books narration time. It is not expanded to all world athletes, gold only, every award, or a freshly verified current ranking.

Like Phelps specifies age-eight serious training, not shared coach, sister or identical weekly hours. Enormous talent and unparalleled devotion are strong descriptive evaluations, not mathematically measured all-human rankings.
In addition to adds tiny details to grueling training in both swimming and gymnastics. They in the sports summary refers to the two sports, not two individual people or all possible sports.

Could cost a medal describes possible loss of a winning opportunity, not payment of an entry fee. The books four-year cycle explains prolonged preparation, not training only once per cycle or a new dated schedule.
A moment versus a decade highlights possible jeopardy to long effort and dreams. Rob is a metaphor for lost outcomes, not literal erasure of a persons past or a criminal event.

Losing interest in sports in which they excelled supports a limited distinction between achievement and ongoing enjoyment; it does not establish every athlete loses interest or that skills and medals were invalid.
The authors account of Phelps and Biles experiences is retained as book narration; no present clinical assessment, fresh diagnosis or universal pressure-causes-disorder conclusion is invented.
Admirable,even virtuous recognises dedication before But too much warns about excess. Could retains possibility rather than declaring all practice harmful or play incompatible with effort.

The name of the game is an idiom for the dominant priority. Gopnik argues for prolonged childhood exploration before adult specialisation; that is an attributed explanatory account, not a uniform training prescription for all children.
